title: Record a Papyrus relevance run for the Cyclotron marketing demo
description:
Export a fixture of real Papyrus reviews changing the relevance cyclotron for the Cyclotron-web services page, in the editorial-run-v1 shape with source papyrus-live, using the engine export (decision-flywheel-de484ad0). Include only explanations whose review was marked shareable; redact others. Pick one review that led to a promoted version and record its before and after decisions. Ordering: last, after at least one promoted version in production.

Acceptance criteria:
- The fixture contains no non-shareable explanation, no editor email and no private corpus text beyond titles and public URLs.
- It names the cyclotron versions and the review that preceded the promotion.
- Ryan approves the fixture before it is copied into Cyclotron-web.,

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented on feature/PPY-54957a-cyclotron-recording (built on PPY-049b6e, PR #173): 'papyrus references export-relevance-recording --output <file>' restores the latest store snapshot (or --store), makes no model call, and writes the editorial-run schema 2 fixture with source papyrus-live: cycles in decision order (title, public URL, decision before review, editor label and reason code, review reason and propensity, cyclotron changes), windows of 100 decisions (metrics and routing on program/audit reviews, cyclotron changes, model calls, wall clock, usage and USD), usage_total, and attribution.price_basis (Jev at TypeSafe's published price; any optimizer price must be given with its source, or the export refuses). Explanations only where the editor ticked 'may be quoted publicly'; --no-explanations removes all; reviewer names never appear. Needs the engine's feat/sdk-usage (Cyclotron f1e1826: SDK usage per decision, Cyclotron.usage(), decision_log()); pyproject pins that commit until it merges. Spec: features_backend/cyclotron-relevance-recording.feature 5/5; all cyclotron backend scenarios 29/29; no new pytest failures. Not yet run on a real store: none exists until a sandbox sweep runs.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Repinned the Python extra to Cyclotron main 9874b71 (feat/sdk-usage merged); poetry.lock changes only that pin. Cyclotron backend scenarios 29/29 including the recording's 5.
